stem:
The diagram shows Yusuf looking at a lamp flame through holes in three cardboard sheets P, Q and R. The holes lie on one straight line.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: He can see the flame because light travels along the straight path through the aligned holes.
He can still see the flame if the hole in Q is moved well off the straight path.
Light from the flame bends freely around the sheets, so hole alignment does not matter.
He can see the flame only when sheets P, Q and R are all removed.

teacher.key_rationale: Light is seen through the path only when the path is straight and the holes are aligned.
teacher.figure_note: Three sheets with aligned holes on a straight path to a lamp.
